mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that may trigger inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 5.0% and S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both increase by more than 1% in the last month but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a 25 basis point increase in the federal funds rate within one month signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% in 1 month, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises by more than 0.5% in the last month but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1000 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST falls below 1000.0 and S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises by more than 0.5% and UNRATE falls by more than 0.2pp in the last month but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0%), a 0.5% decline in retail sales (RSAFS) within one month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0% and RSAFS falls > 0.5% in 1 month, S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
